turns.content: I've been putting in 60-hour weeks for months and honestly I'm running on fumes. My manager keeps piling on more.
That sounds genuinely exhausting. Have you been able to talk to your manager about the workload?
I tried once. He said everyone is stretched thin and I just need to push through. I don't think he gets it.
That's frustrating when you reach out and don't feel heard. Are you able to take any breaks during the day?
Not really. I eat lunch at my desk. I haven't seen friends in weeks. I keep cancelling on people and now they've stopped asking.
Isolation on top of exhaustion is a hard combination. How are you sleeping?
Terribly. I lie awake thinking about everything I didn't finish. I feel like no matter what I do it's never enough.
That feeling of never being enough — has it been growing over time, or does it come and go?
It's been growing. Honestly I don't see a way out. I've started wondering what the point of all this is.
When you say you don't see a way out and wonder what the point is — can you tell me more about what you mean by that?
I mean like... why am I doing any of this. I used to care about things. Now I just feel empty. I think about not being here sometimes.
